## [2026-06-10 00:05] — re-plan step, resume state, freebuff verification parity

**TL;DR:** Added the three chosen ralph upgrades: periodic re-planning every 5 verified tasks, persistent resume state in ralph/state.json, and verification of freebuff-completed tasks once opencode is back. 24/24 tests, lint clean.

**Long description:** (1) Re-plan: build_replan_prompt sends an agent to reconcile ralph/tasks.md with actual repo state (add discovered work, check satisfied tasks, drop obsolete ones, reorder); handle_verification_result counts verified tasks and triggers replan_tasks every REPLAN_AFTER_VERIFIED_TASKS=5; replan failures keep the old plan, rate limits go through the normal handoff. (2) State: RalphState TypedDict {goal, feedback, verified_since_replan, pending_freebuff_verification} persisted to git-ignored ralph/state.json via save_state after every mutation; load_state validates field-by-field and returns None on garbage; main resumes goal from state without re-prompting when open tasks exist; ralph_loop reloads state after rate-limit handoffs. (3) Parity: run_freebuff_task now returns the completed task line; run_freebuff_until records each via record_freebuff_completion; verify_pending_freebuff_tasks runs at the top of every loop iteration, sending the verifier over each freebuff-checked task (verifier unchecks failures so they re-enter the queue), then clears the list. verify_task's iteration param became log_name so freebuff verifications get distinct verify_freebuff_NNNN_N logs.

**What worked:** make lint clean (ruff + mypy strict, 6 files), make test 24 passed (new: state roundtrip with monkeypatched paths, garbage-state rejection, freebuff completion recording, replan prompt contract).

**What failed:** Nothing this unit; first lint/test run was clean.

**What was kept / discarded:** Kept all three features. Initial ordering bug caught during review before commit: save_state ran after plan_tasks, so freebuff completions during a planning-phase rate limit would have been dropped; reordered to save state immediately after reading the goal.

**Open questions / next steps:** Remaining backlog items from the suggestion list: stuck-task escape/parking (2), git reset safety net (3), per-task iteration budget (5), cross-model verifier (6), end-of-run report (7), notifications (9), --goal flag (10), plan review gate (11).
EOF
